scientific_integrity: An exact finite-state kernel, its unique invariant distribution, and a sharp integer-part minimax bound are proved explicitly. A standalone exact-rational program corroborates 41,776 instances; finite cases are not a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only a noiseless scalar quadratic; two-level fixed-point iterate; exact pre-rounded arithmetic; independent per-step randomness; StochasticA-style floor of finite-bit upward probability; fixed 0<eta<1. Results for more general rounding corrections, grids, noise, and numerical implementations are not claimed. Independent historical-priority review is outstanding.
title: A sharp random-bit threshold for invariant bias in two-level quantized gradient descent
